tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

92: /// 当前显示器尺寸 (w, h) —— 随屏幕方向变化,即触摸注入使用的坐标空间。
93: ///
94: /// `wm size` 返回的是设备物理分辨率(始终是自然方向),横屏时会与真实坐标空间
95: /// 不一致(例如 wm size=1280x2772 而横屏实际为 2772x1280),导致按自然方向钳制的
96: /// 坐标落到屏幕外被系统丢弃,因此这里优先取 `dumpsys window displays` 的 cur=WxH。
97: pub fn display_size(serial: &str) -> Result<(u32, u32)> {
98:     if let Ok(out) = adb_cmd(Some(serial))
99:         .args(["shell", "dumpsys", "window", "displays"])
100:         .output()
101:     {
102:         let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout);
103:         if let Some(wh) = parse_display_size(&stdout) {
104:             return Ok(wh);
105:         }
106:     }
107:     screen_size(serial)
108: }
109: 
110: /// 一次「设备侧巡检」的结果(周期性坐标空间重查与设备注入自检共用这一份)。
111: ///
112: /// 每个字段都允许 `None` = **这一轮没读到**,调用方必须把它与"读到了某个值"
113: /// 分开处理 —— 尤其是 [`Self::size`]:一次 adb 抖动绝不能被当成"坐标空间变了",
114: /// 否则会平白无故抬起玩家此刻正按着的所有触点。
115: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
116: pub struct DeviceProbe {
117:     /// 当前触摸坐标空间(`dumpsys window displays` 的 `cur=WxH`)。
118:     pub size: Option<(u32, u32)>,
119:     /// [`Self::size`] 是不是真的来自 `dumpsys` 的 `cur=`(即**当前方向**的空间)。
120:     ///
121:     /// 解析不到时 `size` 会回退成 `wm size` —— 那是**物理分辨率、永远自然方向**:
122:     /// 横屏设备上它与真实坐标空间正好差 90°,拿它跟缓存比对必然误判"空间变了"。
123:     /// 所以回退值只能"看",不能用来判定变化。
124:     pub size_is_display_space: bool,
125:     /// `mCurrentFocus=`(真正拿到输入焦点的窗口)。`null` 原样保留 ——
126:     /// "当前没有焦点窗口"本身就是"注入被系统丢掉"的一条线索。
127:     pub focus: Option<String>,
128:     /// `mFocusedApp=`(前台 ActivityRecord):与 `focus` 一起看才能分清
129:     /// "游戏在前台,但焦点被别的窗口(弹窗/输入法)抢走"。
130:     pub focused_app: Option<String>,
131:     /// 屏幕是否亮着(`dumpsys display` 的 `mScreenState=ON`);读不到为 None。
132:     pub screen_on: Option<bool>,
133: }
134: 
135: impl DeviceProbe {
136:     /// 屏幕亮灭的人话表示(读不到就说"未知",不瞎猜)
137:     pub fn screen_on_text(&self) -> &'static str {
138:         match self.screen_on {
139:             Some(true) => "亮",
140:             Some(false) => "灭",
141:             None => "未知",
142:         }
143:     }
144: 
145:     /// 一句话摘要(日志与悬浮窗共用同一份口径)
146:     pub fn summary(&self) -> String {
147:         format!(
148:             "空间={} 焦点={} 前台={} 屏幕={}",
149:             match self.size {
150:                 Some((w, h)) => format!("{w}x{h}"),
151:                 None => "未知".to_string(),
152:             },
153:             self.focus.as_deref().unwrap_or("未知"),
154:             self.focused_app.as_deref().unwrap_or("未知"),
155:             self.screen_on_text(),
156:         )
157:     }
158: }

160: /// 一次设备侧巡检:坐标空间 + 焦点窗口 + 屏幕亮灭。
161: ///
162: /// 坐标空间沿用 [`display_size`] 的口径(`dumpsys window displays` 的 `cur=` 优先,
163: /// 解析不到回退 `wm size`);焦点窗口/前台 Activity 从同一条 `dumpsys window displays`
164: /// 输出里取(拿不到时补一条完整 `dumpsys window`);屏幕亮灭另取 `dumpsys display`。
165: /// **每条查询都失败也照样返回**:巡检的价值之一是"如实说出这一轮什么都没读到",
166: /// 由调用方决定不动手。
167: pub fn device_probe(serial: &str) -> DeviceProbe {
168:     let mut probe = DeviceProbe::default();
169:     if let Ok(out) = adb_cmd(Some(serial))
170:         .args(["shell", "dumpsys", "window", "displays"])
171:         .output()
172:     {
173:         let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout);
174:         probe.size = parse_display_size(&text);
175:         probe.size_is_display_space = probe.size.is_some();
176:         probe.focus = parse_window_field(&text, "mCurrentFocus=");
177:         probe.focused_app = parse_window_field(&text, "mFocusedApp=");
178:         // 少数 ROM 的 `displays` 变体不打印焦点(只在默认 dump 里)。补一条,
179:         // 别让遥测永远是空的 —— 只有在真的没拿到时才多这一次 adb 调用。
180:         if probe.focus.is_none() || probe.focused_app.is_none() {
181:             if let Ok(out) = adb_cmd(Some(serial))
182:                 .args(["shell", "dumpsys", "window"])
183:                 .output()
184:             {
185:                 let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout);
186:                 if probe.focus.is_none() {
187:                     probe.focus = parse_window_field(&text, "mCurrentFocus=");
188:                 }
189:                 if probe.focused_app.is_none() {
190:                     probe.focused_app = parse_window_field(&text, "mFocusedApp=");
191:                 }
192:             }
193:         }
194:     }
195:     if probe.size.is_none() {
196:         // 回退口径与 `display_size` 一致。注意 `size_is_display_space` 保持 false:
197:         // 这是自然方向的物理分辨率,只能当参考,不能拿来判定"空间变了"。
198:         probe.size = screen_size(serial).ok();
199:     }
200:     if let Ok(out) = adb_cmd(Some(serial))
201:         .args(["shell", "dumpsys", "display"])
202:         .output()
203:     {
204:         probe.screen_on = parse_screen_on(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout));
205:     }
206:     probe
207: }

209: /// 在设备上**用 shell 的 input 命令**点一下 (x, y)。
210: ///
211: /// 这条路**完全绕过本程序的控制通道**(不走 scrcpy 的注入协议、不用我们缓存的
212: /// 坐标空间),所以它是"设备注入自检"里的对照器械:同一下点击,shell 点得动而
213: /// 我们的注入没反应 ⇒ 问题在我们这条通道;两个都没反应 ⇒ 问题在设备/系统层
214: /// (灭屏、焦点被别的窗口抢走、系统挡了注入)。
215: ///
216: /// 成功时返回设备端输出(通常为空),失败返回人话原因 —— 自检要把这句话原样写进
217: /// 日志,不能把"命令没跑成"悄悄吞掉。
218: pub fn input_tap(serial: &str, x: u32, y: u32) -> Result<String> {
219:     let (sx, sy) = (x.to_string(), y.to_string());
220:     let out = adb_cmd(Some(serial))
221:         .args(["shell", "input", "tap", &sx, &sy])
222:         .output()
223:         .context("执行 adb shell input tap 失败")?;
224:     let mut text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).trim().to_string();
225:     let err = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr).trim().to_string();
226:     if !err.is_empty() {
227:         if !text.is_empty() {
228:             text.push(' ');
229:         }
230:         text.push_str(&err);
231:     }
232:     if !out.status.success() {
233:         bail!("input tap 退出码非 0: {text}");
234:     }
235:     Ok(text)
236: }

238: /// 当前显示器刷新率（Hz），用于“其他功能 -> 调试信息”。
239: ///
240: /// Android 没有统一公开的“游戏实时 FPS”查询接口。这里优先读取
241: /// SurfaceFlinger 的刷新周期；失败时回退到 `dumpsys display` 的 refreshRate。
242: pub fn display_refresh_rate(serial: &str) -> Result<f32> {
243:     if let Ok(out) = adb_cmd(Some(serial))
244:         .args(["shell", "dumpsys", "SurfaceFlinger", "--latency"])
245:         .output()
246:     {
247:         let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout);
248:         if let Some(fps) = parse_refresh_rate_latency(&stdout) {
249:             return Ok(fps);
250:         }
251:     }
252:     let out = adb_cmd(Some(serial))
253:         .args(["shell", "dumpsys", "display"])
254:         .output()
255:         .context("执行 adb shell dumpsys display 失败")?;
256:     let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout);
257:     parse_refresh_rate_text(&stdout).context("无法从设备输出解析刷新率")
258: }
259: 
260: fn parse_refresh_rate_latency(text: &str) -> Option<f32> {
261:     let first = text
262:         .lines()
263:         .find_map(|line| line.trim().parse::<f64>().ok());
264:     if let Some(period) = first {
265:         if (1_000.0..=100_000_000.0).contains(&period) {
266:             let fps = 1_000_000_000.0 / period;
267:             if (1.0..=1000.0).contains(&fps) {
268:                 return Some(fps as f32);
269:             }
270:         }
271:     }
272:     let timestamps: Vec<u64> = text
273:         .lines()
274:         .filter_map(|line| line.split(',').next()?.trim().parse().ok())
275:         .filter(|v: &u64| *v > 1_000_000)
276:         .collect();
277:     if timestamps.len() >= 2 {
278:         let first = timestamps[0];
279:         let last = *timestamps.last().unwrap();
280:         if last > first {
281:             let fps = (timestamps.len() - 1) as f64 * 1_000_000_000.0 / (last - first) as f64;
282:             if (1.0..=1000.0).contains(&fps) {
283:                 return Some(fps as f32);
284:             }
285:         }
286:     }
287:     None
288: }
289: 
290: fn parse_refresh_rate_text(text: &str) -> Option<f32> {
291:     for key in ["refreshRate=", "fps="] {
292:         if let Some(value) = parse_float_after(text, key) {
293:             if (1.0..=1000.0).contains(&value) {
294:                 return Some(value as f32);
295:             }
296:         }
297:     }
298:     None
299: }
300: 
301: fn parse_float_after(text: &str, key: &str) -> Option<f32> {
302:     let start = text.find(key)? + key.len();
303:     let rest = text[start..].trim_start();
304:     let end = rest
305:         .find(|c: char| !(c.is_ascii_digit() || c == '.' || c == '-'))
306:         .unwrap_or(rest.len());
307:     rest[..end].parse().ok()
308: }

310: /// 从 `dumpsys window displays` 输出中取当前显示尺寸。
311: /// 每行形如 "... init=1280x2772 520dpi ... cur=2772x1280 app=2772x1280 rng=..." ,
312: /// 取最后一个 cur=(物理显示器,即真正的触摸坐标空间)。
313: fn parse_display_size(dumpsys: &str) -> Option<(u32, u32)> {
314:     dumpsys
315:         .split("cur=")
316:         .skip(1)
317:         .filter_map(parse_size_token)
318:         .last()
319: }
320: 
321: /// 从 dumpsys 文本里取一个 `key=value` 字段的值(取第一处出现;值到行尾)。
322: ///
323: /// `mCurrentFocus=` / `mFocusedApp=` 的行形如:
324: ///
325: /// ```text
326: ///   mCurrentFocus=Window{8b0f3a1 u0 com.tencent.tmgp.dfm/com.epicgames.ue4.GameActivity}
327: ///   mFocusedApp=ActivityRecord{1a2b3c u0 com.tencent.tmgp.dfm/.MainActivity t42}
328: /// ```
329: ///
330: /// 值可能是 `null`(真的没有焦点窗口)—— **原样返回**,调用方据此说"当前没有焦点
331: /// 窗口",而不是当成"没查到"。只有字段不存在或值为空时才是 `None`。
332: fn parse_window_field(text: &str, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
333:     let line = text.lines().find(|l| l.contains(key))?;
334:     let value = line.split_once(key)?.1.trim();
335:     if value.is_empty() {
336:         None
337:     } else {
338:         Some(value.to_string())
339:     }
340: }
341: 
342: /// 从 `dumpsys display` 里取"屏幕亮着吗"。
343: ///
344: /// 各 Android 版本的关键字不同:优先 `mScreenState=`(DisplayContent),
345: /// 退而用 `mGlobalDisplayState=`(DisplayManagerService)。**只认 ON/OFF 两种明确
346: /// 取值** —— DOZE / UNKNOWN 之类一律返回 None:遥测宁可不报,也不能把不确定的
347: /// 状态说成"灭屏"(那会把排查方向整个带偏)。
348: fn parse_screen_on(text: &str) -> Option<bool> {
349:     for key in ["mScreenState=", "mGlobalDisplayState="] {
350:         let Some((_, rest)) = text.split_once(key) else {
351:             continue;
352:         };
353:         let token: String = rest
354:             .trim_start()
355:             .chars()
356:             .take_while(|c| c.is_ascii_uppercase() || *c == '_')
357:             .collect();
358:         match token.as_str() {
359:             "ON" => return Some(true),
360:             "OFF" => return Some(false),
361:             _ => continue,
362:         }
363:     }
364:     None
365: }
366: 
367: /// 从 "2772x1280 rest..." 这样的片段里取出前导的 WxH
368: fn parse_size_token(s: &str) -> Option<(u32, u32)> {
369:     let tok: String = s
370:         .chars()
371:         .take_while(|c| c.is_ascii_digit() || *c == 'x')
372:         .collect();
373:     let mut it = tok.split('x');
374:     let w: u32 = it.next()?.parse().ok()?;
375:     let h: u32 = it.next()?.parse().ok()?;
376:     if w > 0 && h > 0 { Some((w, h)) } else { None }
377: }

393: /// 在 PATH 环境变量中查找可执行文件
394: fn find_in_path(name: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {
395:     let path_env = std::env::var_os("PATH")?;
396:     for dir in std::env::split_paths(&path_env) {
397:         let p = dir.join(name);
398:         if p.is_file() {
399:             return Some(p);
400:         }
401:     }
402:     None
403: }
404: 
405: /// 自动寻找 scrcpy 可执行文件:PATH 优先,其次各平台常见安装位置,
406: /// 最后回退到"程序旁边的便携 scrcpy 目录"。
407: pub fn find_scrcpy() -> Option<PathBuf> {
408:     let path_names: &[&str] = if cfg!(windows) {
409:         &["scrcpy.exe"]
410:     } else {
411:         &["scrcpy"]
412:     };
413:     for name in path_names {
414:         if let Some(p) = find_in_path(name) {
415:             return Some(p);
416:         }
417:     }
418: 
419:     let candidates: Vec<PathBuf> = if cfg!(windows) {
420:         let mut v = vec![
421:             PathBuf::from(r"C:\Program Files\scrcpy\scrcpy.exe"),
422:             PathBuf::from(r"C:\Program Files (x86)\scrcpy\scrcpy.exe"),
423:         ];
424:         if let Some(lo) = std::env::var_os("LOCALAPPDATA") {
425:             v.push(PathBuf::from(&lo).join(r"Programs\scrcpy\scrcpy.exe"));
426:         }
427:         if let Some(home) = std::env::var_os("USERPROFILE") {
428:             v.push(PathBuf::from(&home).join(r"scoop\shims\scrcpy.exe"));
429:         }
430:         v.push(PathBuf::from(r"C:\ProgramData\chocolatey\bin\scrcpy.exe"));
431:         v
432:     } else {
433:         let mut v = vec![
434:             PathBuf::from("/usr/bin/scrcpy"),
435:             PathBuf::from("/usr/local/bin/scrcpy"),
436:             PathBuf::from("/opt/scrcpy/scrcpy"),
437:             PathBuf::from("/snap/bin/scrcpy"),
438:         ];
439:         if let Some(home) = std::env::var_os("HOME") {
440:             v.push(PathBuf::from(&home).join(".local/bin/scrcpy"));
441:         }
442:         v
443:     };
444:     if let Some(p) = candidates.into_iter().find(|p| p.is_file()) {
445:         return Some(p);
446:     }
447: 
448:     // 系统里没装 scrcpy 时,再看程序旁边的便携目录
449:     find_scrcpy_portable()
450: }
451: 
452: /// 用户(或上次记住的设置)明确给出的 scrcpy 位置。
453: ///
454: /// **既接受可执行文件,也接受目录** —— 用户嘴里的"scrcpy 目录"就是发行包解压出来的
455: /// 那个文件夹(scrcpy-win64-vX.Y)。只认 exe 会让"我设置好 scrcpy 目录后,
456: /// 再次启动依旧找不到"这种体验问题反复出现;目录里再多套一层子目录也能命中。
457: pub fn find_scrcpy_explicit(path: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {
458:     let t = path.trim();
459:     if t.is_empty() {
460:         return None;
461:     }
462:     let p = PathBuf::from(t);
463:     if p.is_file() {
464:         return Some(p);
465:     }
466:     if p.is_dir() {
467:         return find_scrcpy_in_dir(&p, 3);
468:     }
469:     None
470: }
471: 
472: /// 在给定目录(含至多 depth 层子目录)里查 scrcpy 可执行文件。
473: /// 文件名精确匹配 `scrcpy.exe`(Windows)/`scrcpy`,因此不会把 `scrcpy-pad.exe` 认错。
474: pub fn find_scrcpy_in_dir(dir: &Path, depth: usize) -> Option<PathBuf> {
475:     find_file_recursive(dir, scrcpy_exe_name(), depth)
476: }
477: 
478: /// 在基准目录"一带"找 scrcpy。与 [`find_scrcpy_in_dir`] 的区别:
479: /// 这里只往**名字像 scrcpy 的子目录**里下探(允许外面再套一层任意名字的文件夹,
480: /// 因为"解压到一个文件夹里"很常见)。
481: ///
482: /// 因此它可以安全地拿桌面、下载目录、用户主目录这类大目录当基准 ——
483: /// 代价只有每层一次 read_dir,不会递归整棵目录树。用户记住的 scrcpy 目录
484: /// 被换版本/改名之后,就是靠它从"上一级"把新版本找回来的。
485: pub fn find_scrcpy_under(base: &Path, depth: usize) -> Option<PathBuf> {
486:     // 1) 基准目录本身就是发行包目录
487:     if let Some(p) = find_scrcpy_in_dir(base, 0) {
488:         return Some(p);
489:     }
490:     // 2) 基准目录下以 scrcpy 开头的子目录(官方发行包解压出来的样子)
491:     for d in scrcpy_named_subdirs(base) {
492:         if let Some(p) = find_scrcpy_in_dir(&d, depth.saturating_sub(1)) {
493:             return Some(p);
494:         }
495:     }
496:     // 3) 再套一层任意名字的文件夹,例如 "D:\下载\一个文件夹\scrcpy-win64-v3.3"
497:     if depth > 0 {
498:         for outer in subdirs(base) {
499:             for d in scrcpy_named_subdirs(&outer) {
500:                 if let Some(p) = find_scrcpy_in_dir(&d, 0) {
501:                     return Some(p);
502:                 }
503:             }
504:         }
505:     }
506:     None
507: }
508: 
509: /// 目录下的子目录(排序,保证结果稳定可测)
510: fn subdirs(dir: &Path) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
511:     let Ok(rd) = std::fs::read_dir(dir) else {
512:         return Vec::new();
513:     };
514:     let mut v: Vec<PathBuf> = rd
515:         .flatten()
516:         .filter(|e| e.file_type().map(|t| t.is_dir()).unwrap_or(false))
517:         .map(|e| e.path())
518:         .collect();
519:     v.sort();
520:     v
521: }
522: 
523: /// 目录下名字以 "scrcpy" 开头的子目录
524: fn scrcpy_named_subdirs(dir: &Path) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
525:     subdirs(dir)
526:         .into_iter()
527:         .filter(|p| is_scrcpy_dir_name(p))
528:         .collect()
529: }
530: 
531: /// 在"程序目录附近"寻找便携部署的 scrcpy。
532: ///
533: /// 扫描程序所在目录及其父目录下、名字以 "scrcpy" 开头的文件夹
534: /// (对应"把官方 scrcpy 发行包解压到主程序旁边"的用法),
535: /// 并在其中(至多 3 层子目录)查找 scrcpy 可执行文件。
536: /// 找到后,同目录的 scrcpy-server 与 adb 会由既有联动逻辑自动补齐。
537: pub fn find_scrcpy_portable() -> Option<PathBuf> {
538:     for base in program_base_dirs() {
539:         if let Some(exe) = find_scrcpy_portable_under(&base) {
540:             return Some(exe);
541:         }
542:     }
543:     None
544: }

546: /// 在给定基准目录附近寻找便携 scrcpy:
547: /// 先看基准目录内部,再看其父目录(即"同级"位置)下的 scrcpy* 子目录。
548: fn find_scrcpy_portable_under(base: &Path) -> Option<PathBuf> {
549:     // 候选扫描根:程序目录本身;以及程序目录的父目录(即"同级"位置)
550:     let mut roots = vec![base.to_path_buf()];
551:     if let Some(parent) = base.parent() {
552:         roots.push(parent.to_path_buf());
553:     }
554:     roots
555:         .into_iter()
556:         .find_map(|root| find_scrcpy_under(&root, 3))
557: }

559: /// 目录名是否以 "scrcpy" 开头(不区分大小写)
560: fn is_scrcpy_dir_name(p: &Path) -> bool {
561:     p.file_name()
562:         .map(|n| {
563:             n.to_string_lossy()
564:                 .to_ascii_lowercase()
565:                 .starts_with("scrcpy")
566:         })
567:         .unwrap_or(false)
568: }

570: /// 程序所在目录:优先可执行文件所在目录,其次当前工作目录
571: fn program_base_dirs() -> Vec<PathBuf> {
572:     let mut v = Vec::new();
573:     if let Ok(exe) = std::env::current_exe() {
574:         if let Some(dir) = exe.parent() {
575:             v.push(dir.to_path_buf());
576:         }
577:     }
578:     if let Ok(cwd) = std::env::current_dir() {
579:         if !v.contains(&cwd) {
580:             v.push(cwd);
581:         }
582:     }
583:     v
584: }

586: /// 在目录树中按文件名查找(深度受限,避免无谓的大范围遍历)
587: fn find_file_recursive(dir: &Path, name: &str, depth: usize) -> Option<PathBuf> {
588:     let direct = dir.join(name);
589:     if direct.is_file() {
590:         return Some(direct);
591:     }
592:     if depth == 0 {
593:         return None;
594:     }
595:     let rd = std::fs::read_dir(dir).ok()?;
596:     let mut subs: Vec<PathBuf> = rd
597:         .flatten()
598:         .filter(|e| e.file_type().map(|t| t.is_dir()).unwrap_or(false))
599:         .map(|e| e.path())
600:         .collect();
601:     subs.sort();
602:     for sub in subs {
603:         if let Some(found) = find_file_recursive(&sub, name, depth - 1) {
604:             return Some(found);
605:         }
606:     }
607:     None
608: }

636: /// 自动寻找 adb:手动指定的 scrcpy 同目录优先,其次 PATH,最后平台常见安装位置
637: /// (Android SDK platform-tools)。scrcpy_exe 传 None 时跳过"同目录"阶段。
638: pub fn find_adb(scrcpy_exe: Option<&Path>) -> Option<PathBuf> {

640:     if let Some(exe) = scrcpy_exe {

649:         return Some(p);

651:     // 3. 平台常见安装位置
652:     let candidates: Vec<PathBuf> = if cfg!(windows) {
653:         let mut v = Vec::new();

655:             v.push(PathBuf::from(&lo).join(r"Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe"));

657:         if let Some(home) = std::env::var_os("USERPROFILE") {
658:             v.push(PathBuf::from(&home).join(r"AppData\Local\Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe"));
659:         }
660:         v
661:     } else {
662:         Vec::new()
663:     };

745: /// 启动一个 control-only 的 scrcpy-server(无视频无音频,仅控制通道),
746: /// 返回 (server 子进程, 本地转发端口)。
747: pub fn start_control_server(
748:     serial: &str,
749:     server_path: &str,
750:     version: &str,
751:     scid: u32,
752:     port: u16,
753: ) -> Result<ControlServer> {
754:     let socket_name = format!("scrcpy_{scid:08x}");
755:     const DEVICE_JAR: &str = "/data/local/tmp/scrcpy-server-pad.jar";
756: 
757:     // server 必须推送到设备侧路径(scrcpy 官方行为相同,推入 /data/local/tmp)
758:     // 路径直接作为参数传递,不经 shell,空格/中文路径安全
759:     let st = adb_cmd(Some(serial))
760:         .args(["push", server_path, DEVICE_JAR])
761:         .output()
762:         .context("adb push scrcpy-server 失败")?;
763:     if !st.status.success() {
764:         bail!("adb push 失败: {}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&st.stderr));
765:     }
766: 
767:     // 先建立 forward,再启动 server(server 会 listen 并等待 accept)
768:     let st = adb_cmd(Some(serial))
769:         .args([
770:             "forward",
771:             &format!("tcp:{port}"),
772:             &format!("localabstract:{socket_name}"),
773:         ])
774:         .output()
775:         .context("adb forward 失败")?;
776:     if !st.status.success() {
777:         bail!("adb forward 失败: {}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&st.stderr));
778:     }
779: 
780:     let args = format!(
781:         "CLASSPATH={DEVICE_JAR} app_process / com.genymobile.scrcpy.Server {version} \
782:          scid={scid:08x} tunnel_forward=true video=false audio=false control=true \
783:          send_device_meta=false send_frame_meta=false send_stream_meta=false \
784:          send_dummy_byte=true cleanup=true power_on=false log_level=warn"
785:     );
786:     let mut child = adb_cmd(Some(serial))
787:         .args(["shell", &args])
788:         .stdout(Stdio::null())
789:         .stderr(Stdio::piped())
790:         .spawn()
791:         .context("启动 scrcpy-server 失败")?;
792:     if let Some(stderr) = child.stderr.take() {
793:         std::thread::spawn(move || {
794:             for line in BufReader::new(stderr).lines().map_while(Result::ok) {
795:                 // 设备端 server 的 stderr 是我们**唯一**能看见它内部事故的地方
796:                 // (`Exception` / 反序列化失败 / 读线程炸掉)。所以:
797:                 //   * 疑似错误的行升级到 ERROR —— 即便用户把日志级别压到 `error`
798:                 //     也不会被过滤掉,并记进"最近一条 server 侧错误"给界面显示;
799:                 //   * 其余行保持 WARN(本来就是 `log_level=warn`)。
800:                 if server_stderr_is_error(&line) {
801:                     note_server_error(&line);
802:                     crate::diag_error!("scrcpy-server", "{line}");
803:                 } else {
804:                     crate::diag_warn!("scrcpy-server", "{line}");
805:                 }
806:             }
807:         });
808:     }
809: 
810:     Ok(ControlServer {
811:         child,
812:         serial: serial.to_string(),
813:         port,
814:     })
815: }
816: 
817: pub struct ControlServer {
818:     child: Child,
819:     serial: String,
820:     port: u16,
821: }
822: 
823: impl Drop for ControlServer {
824:     fn drop(&mut self) {
825:         // 退出清理必须是有界的：kill 后只轮询 try_wait，绝不无条件 wait。
826:         let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_millis(800);
827:         let _ = self.child.kill();
828:         while Instant::now() < deadline {
829:             match self.child.try_wait() {
830:                 Ok(Some(_)) => break,
831:                 Ok(None) => std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)),
832:                 Err(_) => break,
833:             }
834:         }
835:         // adb forward 清理同样设置超时，避免 adb server 异常时把 GUI 退出卡住。
836:         if let Ok(mut child) = adb_cmd(Some(&self.serial))
837:             .args(["forward", "--remove", &format!("tcp:{}", self.port)])
838:             .stdout(Stdio::null())
839:             .stderr(Stdio::null())
840:             .spawn()
841:         {
842:             let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_millis(600);
843:             while Instant::now() < deadline {
844:                 match child.try_wait() {
845:                     Ok(Some(_)) => break,
846:                     Ok(None) => std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)),
847:                     Err(_) => break,
848:                 }
849:             }
850:             if child.try_wait().ok().flatten().is_none() {
851:                 let _ = child.kill();
852:             }
853:         }
854:     }
855: }

857: // ===================== 控制通道存活自检 =====================
858: //
859: // 为什么需要它(2026-10-11 用户真机现场,FPS 模式内锁死):
860: // 我们的 control-only server 实例死了/不再接收时,`adb forward` 这一层**照样
861: // 把写入吞掉** —— 本地 write 成功、`ControlClient::is_connected()` 一直为真、
862: // 日志零错误,而设备端一个触点都收不到。所以"我们这条通道还活着吗"必须去
863: // **设备侧**取证,不能只看本地 socket。
864: //
865: // 两条证据都要能区分"**没查到**"与"**查到没有**":前者(adb 抖动、权限被拒、
866: // 输出不可信)必须报 [`ChannelVerdict::Unknown`],绝不能当成"死" —— 误判的
867: // 代价是无缘无故重启一条本来好的通道。
868: 
869: /// 一次控制通道存活自检的结论。
870: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
871: pub enum ChannelVerdict {
872:     /// 设备端确认在:abstract socket 在,或(退路)进程表里见到我们的 server
873:     Alive,
874:     /// 设备端确认不在:socket 消失,或进程表里连我们的 server 都没有
875:     Dead,
876:     /// 这次**没取到可信证据** —— 不下结论,也绝不触发重连
877:     Unknown,
878: }
879: 
880: impl ChannelVerdict {
881:     /// 界面用的一字标签
882:     pub fn label(self) -> &'static str {
883:         match self {
884:             ChannelVerdict::Alive => "活",
885:             ChannelVerdict::Dead => "死",
886:             ChannelVerdict::Unknown => "未知",
887:         }
888:     }
889: 
890:     /// 这个结论允不允许走"重启通道"这一步。
891:     ///
892:     /// **只有"确认死"允许**:`Unknown`(查询没成/输出不可信)必须什么都不做 ——
893:     /// 这是整条自检最容易写错、后果也最重的一处(误判会把一条好通道重启掉),
894:     /// 所以单独做成一个带单测的纯函数,而不是散在调用点上的 `== Dead`。
895:     pub fn may_restart(self) -> bool {
896:         matches!(self, ChannelVerdict::Dead)
897:     }
898: }
899: 
900: /// 一次存活自检的结果:结论 + 人话证据(日志与界面直接照抄)。
901: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
902: pub struct ChannelProbe {
903:     pub verdict: ChannelVerdict,
904:     /// 证词:两条查询各自查到了什么,判死/判活/判未知分别靠哪一条
905:     pub evidence: String,
906: }
907: 
908: /// 只读问一次设备端:我们自己那个 server 的 abstract socket 还在不在。
909: ///
910: /// 返回 `None` = 这次查询本身没成(`adb` 失败 / 输出不像 `/proc/net/unix`),
911: /// 由调用方按"未知"处理。
912: pub fn control_socket_liveness(serial: &str, scid: u32) -> Option<bool> {
913:     let out = adb_cmd(Some(serial))
914:         .args(["shell", "cat", "/proc/net/unix"])
915:         .output()
916:         .ok()?;
917:     if !out.status.success() {
918:         return None;
919:     }
920:     parse_unix_has_socket(
921:         &String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout),
922:         &format!("scrcpy_{scid:08x}"),
923:     )
924: }
925: 
926: /// 退路证据:进程表里还有没有**我们**那个 server。
927: ///
928: /// 返回 `None` = 查不到可信证据(adb 失败 / 输出为空 / 只见到别的 scrcpy 实例
929: /// —— 用户自己那条投屏通道也叫 `com.genymobile.scrcpy.Server`)。
930: pub fn control_server_liveness(serial: &str, scid: u32) -> Option<bool> {
931:     // `-o PID,NAME,ARGS` 才看得到完整启动参数(jar 名与 scid 都在里面);
932:     // 老 toybox 不认 `-o` 时退回朴素的 `ps -A`。
933:     let with_o = adb_cmd(Some(serial))
934:         .args(["shell", "ps", "-A", "-o", "PID,NAME,ARGS"])
935:         .output()
936:         .ok()?;
937:     if with_o.status.success() {
938:         return parse_ps_pad_server(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&with_o.stdout), scid);
939:     }
940:     let plain = adb_cmd(Some(serial))
941:         .args(["shell", "ps", "-A"])
942:         .output()
943:         .ok()?;
944:     if !plain.status.success() {
945:         return None;
946:     }
947:     parse_ps_pad_server(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&plain.stdout), scid)
948: }
949: 
950: /// 存活自检主入口(工作线程里调用;全部是只读 adb 查询)。
951: ///
952: /// 判定顺序:先看 abstract socket(最直接:这条通道就是它),socket 查不到时
953: /// 用进程表兜底。socket **确认消失**即判死 —— `tunnel_forward=true` 下 server
954: /// 自己 listen 在这个名字上,名字没了就没有任何东西会收我们的写入。
955: pub fn channel_probe(serial: &str, scid: u32) -> ChannelProbe {
956:     let socket_name = format!("scrcpy_{scid:08x}");
957:     match control_socket_liveness(serial, scid) {
958:         Some(true) => ChannelProbe {
959:             verdict: ChannelVerdict::Alive,
960:             evidence: format!("设备端 socket {socket_name} 在"),
961:         },
962:         Some(false) => {
963:             // 名字没了。顺带记一句进程表的结果当旁证:进程还在而名字没了,
964:             // 说明坏在我们这条通道而不是整个 adb/设备。
965:             let ps = match control_server_liveness(serial, scid) {
966:                 Some(true) => "ps 仍见我们的 server 进程",
967:                 Some(false) => "ps 也见不到我们的 server 进程",
968:                 None => "ps 未能交叉确认",
969:             };
970:             ChannelProbe {
971:                 verdict: ChannelVerdict::Dead,
972:                 evidence: format!("设备端 socket {socket_name} 已消失({ps})"),
973:             }
974:         }
975:         None => match control_server_liveness(serial, scid) {
976:             Some(true) => ChannelProbe {
977:                 verdict: ChannelVerdict::Alive,
978:                 evidence: format!(
979:                     "/proc/net/unix 这次没取到,但 ps 见到我们的 server 进程({socket_name})"
980:                 ),
981:             },
982:             Some(false) => ChannelProbe {
983:                 verdict: ChannelVerdict::Dead,
984:                 evidence: format!(
985:                     "/proc/net/unix 这次没取到,ps 也不见我们的 server 进程({socket_name})"
986:                 ),
987:             },
988:             None => ChannelProbe {
989:                 verdict: ChannelVerdict::Unknown,
990:                 evidence: format!(
991:                     "/proc/net/unix 与 ps 两条路都没取到可信结果({socket_name});按未知处理,不重连"
992:                 ),
993:             },
994:         },
995:     }
996: }
997: 
998: /// 解析 `/proc/net/unix`,看有没有我们那个 abstract socket(纯函数,单测覆盖)。
999: ///
1000: /// 返回 `None` ⇔ **这份输出不可信**(空输出 / 没有 `Num` 表头 / 只有表头),
1001: /// 必须是"未知"而不是"死"。真机输出长这样(小米 HyperOS,Android 15):
1002: ///
1003: /// ```text
1004: /// Num       RefCount Protocol Flags    Type St Inode Path
1005: /// 0000000000000000: 00000003 00000000 00000000 0001 03 276288363 @scrcpy_1a2b3c4d
1006: /// ```
1007: ///
1008: /// abstract socket 在路径列带 `@` 前缀(老内核不带),两种都认。
1009: pub(crate) fn parse_unix_has_socket(text: &str, socket_name: &str) -> Option<bool> {
1010:     let mut lines = text.lines().filter(|l| !l.trim().is_empty());
1011:     let header = lines.next()?;
1012:     if !header.trim_start().starts_with("Num") {
1013:         return None;

1015:     let mut rows = 0usize;
1016:     for line in lines {
1017:         rows += 1;
1018:         if line
1019:             .split_whitespace()
1020:             .any(|f| f.trim_start_matches('@') == socket_name)
1021:         {
1022:             return Some(true);
1023:         }
1024:     }
1025:     if rows == 0 {
1026:         // 只有表头:这份输出不完整,不能当成"设备上一个 socket 都没有"
1027:         return None;

1048:             continue;
1049:         }
1050:         rows += 1;
1051:         if line.contains(PAD_JAR) || line.contains(&scid_tok) {
1052:             return Some(true);

1054:         if line.contains("scrcpy") {
1055:             foreign_scrcpy = true;
1056:         }

1063:         return None;

1158: /// 从 scrcpy 的一行输出里解析 `--print-fps` 的帧率 —— 投屏流的**真实**帧率。
1159: ///
1160: /// scrcpy 的 FPS 计数器每秒打印一行,格式(见 scrcpy 源码 `run_fps_counter`):
1161: /// `%u fps` 或 `%u fps (+%u frames skipped)`;经 scrcpy 的日志器会带上
1162: /// `INFO: ` 前缀,再经本程序日志通道转发时又会加 `scrcpy stdout: ` 前缀,
1163: /// 所以两种前缀都剥掉。只认"数字 + fps(+ 可选括号说明)"的干净行,避免把
1164: /// 别的含 " fps" 的字串(参数回显之类)误吃进来。
1165: pub(crate) fn parse_scrcpy_fps(line: &str) -> Option<f32> {
1166:     let t = line.trim();
1167:     let t = t.strip_prefix("scrcpy stdout: ").unwrap_or(t).trim_start();
1168:     let t = t
1169:         .strip_prefix("INFO: ")
1170:         .or_else(|| t.strip_prefix("DEBUG: "))
1171:         .unwrap_or(t);
1172:     let (num, rest) = t.split_once(" fps")?;
1173:     let v: f32 = num.trim().parse().ok()?;
1174:     let rest = rest.trim();
1175:     if !(rest.is_empty() || rest.starts_with('(')) {
1176:         return None;
1177:     }
1178:     // 0 是计数器停摆的占位;"每小时几十万帧"不可能是真实读数,当解析失败
1179:     (v > 0.0 && v <= 1000.0).then_some(v)
1180: }

1182: /// 启动常规 scrcpy 窗口。子进程 stdout/stderr 会逐行写入 diagnostics.log，
1183: /// 同时监控退出码，避免 GUI 只显示“已启动”而实际参数错误导致进程秒退。
1184: ///
1185: /// 返回值里的 `u32` 是 scrcpy **子进程的 pid**(用户 2026-10-11 第二个问题 S①):
1186: /// 「鼠标独占」的"仅投屏窗口在前台"档要靠它判定 —— 前台窗口的 pid 等于它,
1187: /// 就说明用户此刻正在投屏窗口里操作(判据见 `capture::foreground_pid` 与
1188: /// `keymap::mouse_shield_on`)。以前这里只返回 stdout 通道,pid 直接丢在
1189: /// 内部那个等待线程里,界面无从比较。
1190: pub fn launch_scrcpy(exe: &str, serial: &str, extra_args: &str) -> Result<(Receiver<String>, u32)> {
1191:     let exe = if exe.trim().is_empty() { "scrcpy" } else { exe };
1192:     let mut cmd = Command::new(exe);
1193:     if !serial.is_empty() {
1194:         cmd.args(["-s", serial]);
1195:     }
1196:     let args = split_args(extra_args);
1197:     for a in &args {
1198:         cmd.arg(a);
1199:     }
1200:     let command_line = format!(
1201:         "{} -s {}{}",
1202:         exe,
1203:         serial,
1204:         if args.is_empty() {
1205:             String::new()
1206:         } else {
1207:             format!(" {}", args.join(" "))
1208:         }
1209:     );
1210:     crate::diag_info!("scrcpy", "启动: {command_line}");
1211:     let mut child = cmd
1212:         .stdout(Stdio::piped())
1213:         .stderr(Stdio::piped())
1214:         .spawn()
1215:         .with_context(|| format!("启动 scrcpy 失败: {exe}"))?;
1216:     let pid = child.id();
1217:     let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel();
1218:     if let Some(stdout) = child.stdout.take() {
1219:         let tx = tx.clone();
1220:         std::thread::spawn(move || {
1221:             for line in BufReader::new(stdout).lines().map_while(Result::ok) {
1222:                 // --print-fps 的行一秒一条:它只服务于界面的"投屏帧率"显示,
1223:                 // 记 info 级会把诊断日志刷爆 —— 降为 debug,需要时开级别看。
1224:                 if parse_scrcpy_fps(&line).is_some() {
1225:                     crate::diag_debug!("scrcpy", "stdout: {line}");
1226:                 } else {
1227:                     crate::diag_info!("scrcpy", "stdout: {line}");
1228:                 }
1229:                 let _ = tx.send(format!("scrcpy stdout: {line}"));
1230:             }
1231:         });
1232:     }
1233:     if let Some(stderr) = child.stderr.take() {
1234:         let tx = tx.clone();
1235:         std::thread::spawn(move || {
1236:             for line in BufReader::new(stderr).lines().map_while(Result::ok) {
1237:                 crate::diag_warn!("scrcpy", "stderr: {line}");
1238:                 let _ = tx.send(format!("scrcpy stderr: {line}"));
1239:             }
1240:         });
1241:     }
1242:     std::thread::spawn(move || {
1243:         let message = match child.wait() {
1244:             Ok(status) if status.success() => {
1245:                 crate::diag_info!("scrcpy", "进程 {pid} 正常退出: {status}");
1246:                 format!("scrcpy 已退出（正常，{status}）")
1247:             }
1248:             Ok(status) => {
1249:                 crate::diag_warn!("scrcpy", "进程 {pid} 异常退出: {status}");
1250:                 format!(
1251:                     "scrcpy 异常退出（{status}）。请查看 diagnostics.log 中 scrcpy 的 stderr 输出"
1252:                 )
1253:             }
1254:             Err(error) => {
1255:                 crate::diag_warn!("scrcpy", "进程 {pid} 等待失败: {error}");
1256:                 format!("无法获取 scrcpy 退出状态: {error}")
1257:             }
1258:         };
1259:         let _ = tx.send(message);
1260:     });
1261:     Ok((rx, pid))
1262: }

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""把 `cargo clippy --all-targets` 的告警与基线比对（W2-5 / 审计方案的验证纪律之一）。

用法::

    python ci/clippy_diff.py            # 只报告，永远退出 0（信息性）
    python ci/clippy_diff.py --strict   # 出现"新增/消失"即退出 1

口径与《全面审计与提升方案-2026-10-05.md》里历次实施记录一致：

* 比对的是 **(文件, 消息文本) 去重集合**，不是行号 —— 行号每次重构都会动，
  消息文本才代表"同一类告警"；
* 基线文件 `ci/clippy-baseline.txt` 每行 `src/xxx.rs: warning: <消息>`，
  由维护者在"确认每一对都是既有构造"之后手工更新（更新时要在方案文档里记账）；
* 本机（Windows）的基线是 36 对；GitHub runner 上的 rustc 版本可能更新，
  因此 CI 把它当**信息性**步骤，不拦提交。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import io
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
BASELINE = os.path.join(HERE, "clippy-baseline.txt")
BS = chr(92)  # 反斜杠

# Windows 控制台/重定向管道的默认编码是 GBK 或 cp1252，直接 print 中文会炸；
# 统一按 UTF-8 输出（本项目在 Windows + Linux 两边都跑这个脚本）。
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")


def load_baseline(path: str) -> set[tuple[str, str]]:
    pairs: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    with io.open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        for line in fh:
            line = line.rstrip("\n")
            m = re.match(r"^(src[^:]+): warning: (.*)$", line)
            if m:
                pairs.add((m.group(1).replace(BS, "/"), m.group(2).strip()))
    return pairs


def run_clippy() -> set[tuple[str, str]]:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["cargo", "clippy", "--all-targets"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        errors="replace",
    )
    pairs: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    current = None
    for line in proc.stderr.splitlines():
        m = re.match(r"^warning: (.*)", line)
        if m and not line.startswith("warning: `scrcpy-pad`"):
            current = m.group(1).strip()
        m2 = re.match(r"^\s+--> (src[^:]+):\d+:\d+", line)
        if m2 and current:
            pairs.add((m2.group(1).replace(BS, "/"), current))
            current = None
    return pairs


def main() -> int:
    strict = "--strict" in sys.argv
    baseline = load_baseline(BASELINE)
    current = run_clippy()
    new = sorted(current - baseline)
    gone = sorted(baseline - current)

    print(f"当前告警对: {len(current)}   基线对: {len(baseline)}")
    print("--- 新增（当前有、基线没有）---")
    for f, msg in new:
        print(f"  {f} | {msg}")
    print("--- 消失（基线有、当前没有）---")
    for f, msg in gone:

[package]
name = "scrcpy-pad"
version = "0.2.0"
edition = "2024"
description = "A keyboard-mapping game console layered on top of scrcpy (virtual joystick, tap/hold/swipe injection)"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/Azrl-lyh/scrcpy-pad"
keywords = ["scrcpy", "android", "gamepad", "keymapping"]
categories = ["emulators", "games"]

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.104"
directories = "6.0.0"
eframe = { version = "0.36.1", default-features = false, features = ["glow", "default_fonts", "x11", "wayland"] }
egui = "0.36.1"
image = { version = "0.25.10", default-features = false, features = ["png", "jpeg"] }
# 使用说明窗口的 markdown 解析(轻量纯 Rust CommonMark 解析器,只取解析结果自行渲染到 egui)
pulldown-cmark = { version = "0.13", default-features = false }
serde = { version = "1.0.229", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.151"
# 键位配置改成 YAML(多套"按键组合"装在一个文件里,字段说明写在文件头注释中)。
# 用 serde_norway 而不是已归档的 serde_yaml:两者 API 一致,但它是仍在维护的分支。
serde_norway = "0.9"

# Linux: evdev 全局键盘捕获 + xdg-portal 原生文件对话框
# (rfd 的 xdg-portal 后端要求配套 async 运行时特性,选 async-std)
[target.'cfg(target_os = "linux")'.dependencies]
evdev = "0.13.2"
rfd = { version = "0.15", default-features = false, features = ["xdg-portal", "async-std"] }
pollster = "0.4"
# 诊断日志需要本地时区(与 journalctl 对齐时间线):用 localtime_r。
# libc 本来就在依赖树里(evdev 要求),所以零额外编译成本。
libc = "0.2"

# Windows: 自己装的低级键盘/鼠标钩子(见 capture.rs 的说明:rdev 在钩子回调里
# 调 AttachThreadInput/ToUnicodeEx 取一个我们用不到的 key name,会阻塞到超时并
# 被系统静默丢事件)+ 原生文件对话框 + 少量 Win32 调用
[target.'cfg(windows)'.dependencies]
rfd = { version = "0.15", default-features = false }
windows-sys = { version = "0.59", features = [
    "Win32_Foundation",
    "Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging",
    # Raw Input(RegisterRawInputDevices/GetRawInputData/RAWMOUSE,W1-2)由它带入
    "Win32_UI_Input_KeyboardAndMouse",
    "Win32_System_SystemInformation",
    "Win32_System_Threading",
    # 单实例守卫用 CreateMutexW:windows-sys 0.59 把它同时挂在 Win32_Security
    # 下(参数类型 SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES 属于那个模块),少了这个 feature 会 E0432。
    "Win32_Security",
    # GetModuleHandleW:Raw Input 接收窗口要按模块注册窗口类(W1-2)
    "Win32_System_LibraryLoader",
    "Win32_Graphics_Gdi",
] }

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1
strip = true
opt-level = 2

// 只有把触点全部抬到 0(唤醒键)再重建手势才解得开。
// ⇒「设备端现在到底有几个触点、我们的注入被谁拦了」必须去**设备侧**取证。

// 一旦会改变现场,就不再是取证了。

/// GUI/自愈路径绝不能被一条卡住的 adb 查询挂死。
/// 只读查询的输出上限:对端异常时也不让内存无界增长
/// 收尾 kill 之后的等待上限(与 `ControlServer::drop` 同口径,绝不无条件 wait)
/// 设备端输入状态快照(一次 `dumpsys input` 的解析结果)
/// 每个「取不到」都用 `None` 表示:**未知 ≠ 否**。消费方必须把 `None` 当成
/// 「这一轮没有证据」而不是 0 —— 一次 adb 抖动被读成「账本 0 个触点」,
/// 足以骗出一次毫无必要的手势重建。
/// `mInjectEventStatus`(MIUI 私有,AOSP 没有这个字段;读不到为 0)
/// `mIsFilterInterceptMode`(MIUI 私有;缺字段/值不认识一律 false)

/// 账本里当前按下的触点数;`None` = 没解析出来(不是 0)
/// 纯函数:解析 `dumpsys input` 全文(单测用 fixture,不碰设备)。
/// 容错口径:字段缺失 / 格式不认识 ⇒ 默认值或 `None`,**绝不 panic**。
/// `TouchStates` 各版 ROM 没有稳定打印契约(真机空闲时实测是
/// `TouchStates: <no displays touched>`,**有触点时的确切样式没见过**),
/// 所以只认明确认得出的形态,认不出就是 `None`。
/// 命令失败 / 没拿到任何输出 ⇒ `None`。

/// 用 `getevent -pl` 找出触摸屏的 event 节点(只读)。

/// 查询失败或没有这样的节点 ⇒ `None`。

/// 设备端触点从 0 变成 >0:有手指按下去了

/// 只读监听「手摸手机屏」:起一个线程跑
/// `adb -s <serial> shell getevent -lt <触摸屏节点>`,把 0→>0 / >0→0 的边沿发给界面。
/// 调用方 drop 接收端 ⇒ 下一次 `send` 失败 ⇒ 线程收工并 kill 子进程。

return; // 没有触摸屏 / 查询失败:没人可听,安静收工
